objective: Replace Superflow's minimal SystemTextInserter with the full paste backend described in the supplied TextInsertion.swift, adapted to L0/L1 boundaries, Swift 6 strict concurrency, and the 400-line file limit. The backend must detect focus, verify Accessibility trust, validate the target app, resolve the layout-correct Cmd+V key, write a transient clipboard entry, verify the paste, fall back to AX insertion, restore the clipboard only when safe, and report an outcome the Island can turn into its existing copy-transcript card. HotkeyEngine must ignore the synthetic events this backend posts, and the Island failure card must use the finalized transcript rather than the last partial.
end_state: Packages/L1-Adapters/TextInsertion builds and tests cleanly under Swift 6.4 with no transcript text in logs. SystemTextInserter still conforms to SuperflowPorts.TextInserter and now exposes prepareForInsertion() at record start, a detailed TextInsertionReport, strategy-correct paste/AX/clipboard behavior, secure-field blocking, a never-lose-text failure path, and 500 ms guarded clipboard restore after paste or AX success. HotkeyEngine ignores marker-tagged events in both taps. SessionEngine prepares before warm-up and inserts under an 8 s deadline with a clipboardOnly fallback. IslandBridge feeds the failure card the finalized repository transcript. make lint, the four targeted package tests/builds, and the manual matrix pass.
non_goals: Fn double-tap or right-Command gesture changes; only synthetic-event filtering is in scope.
Filler/duplicate cleanup, GPU/model work, or prompt files.
New Island UI: the failure/copy card already exists; only its transcript source is corrected.
App Store sandboxing or a new distribution mechanism.
Changing the existing InsertionOutcome cases beyond the additive prepare hook.

environment.runtime: macOS 15+ deployment target; verified on Swift 6.4 / Xcode 27.1 / macOS 27.2 SDK
environment.test_command: swift test --package-path Packages/L1-Adapters/TextInsertion && swift test --package-path Packages/L1-Adapters/HotkeyEngine && swift test --package-path Packages/L2-Engines/SessionEngine && swift build --package-path App/SuperflowApp && make lint
environment.notes: Repository has a 400-line hard limit per Swift source file (tools/lint-forbidden) and forbids print() in packages/app. The current TextInsertion package builds today. Swift and Xcode are installed in this environment. The supplied reference file is vendored under sandbox/text-insertion-backend/reference/TextInsertion.swift and is not compiled.

components.name: Focus inspection
components.description: Main-actor-confined AX target wrapper, pure value+range replacement, pure role/subrole/settable classification, secure-field detection, Chromium detection, and record-start AX preparation.

components.name: Paste engine
components.description: Clipboard snapshot and transient write, guarded restore, modifier release wait, layout-aware key resolution, private-source Cmd+V with a marker, paste verification, and Accessibility insertion fallback.

components.name: Report and adapter
components.description: A detailed TextInsertionReport with a fixed step vocabulary and a SystemTextInserter adapter that maps every result to the existing SuperflowPorts.InsertionOutcome while preserving each InsertionStrategy's semantics.

components.name: Session and Island integration
components.description: SessionEngine prepares at record start, inserts under a safe deadline with a clipboard fallback, and IslandBridge rebuilds a failure card from the finalized repository record.

components.name: Hotkey isolation
components.description: Both HotkeyEngine event taps drop events whose eventSourceUserData equals the synthetic marker so the app never reacts to its own Cmd+V.

components.name: Verification and docs
components.description: Unit, service, cross-package, and manual tests plus an ADR, permissions runbook note, and PLAN.md section update.

open_questions: For a secure field, should the transcript be auto-copied as concealed clipboard text, or only offered through the Island Copy button? This plan keeps the existing safe behavior (do not write the clipboard) and relies on the Island card.
Should an Accessibility-fallback success restore the old clipboard after the same 500 ms delay, or immediately? This plan uses the same guarded 500 ms delay for both success paths.

If the user switches apps during a long recording, should the transcript go to the app that was frontmost at record start or to the current frontmost app? This plan uses the current app unless Superflow itself is frontmost, then the captured start PID.

tasks.title: Hotkey taps ignore synthetic events
tasks.description: Harden both HotkeyEngine tap callbacks to return the event unchanged when its eventSourceUserData equals SyntheticInputMarker.value. This is defence-in-depth: the current gesture state is usually idle by insertion time, but a marked keyDown must never be able to cancel dictation if the state is armed.
building_blocks: early-return guard at the top of handlePassive and handleActive

files.what: Add public static func isSynthetic(_ event: CGEvent) -> Bool comparing eventSourceUserData to SyntheticInputMarker.value.
In handlePassive and handleActive, after tap-disabled handling, return Unmanaged.passUnretained(event) when KeyEventMapper.isSynthetic(event) is true.
Add tests: marked key event is synthetic, unmarked is not, and an empty user-data field is not.

subtasks.description: Add isSynthetic comparing event.getIntegerValueField(.eventSourceUserData) to SyntheticInputMarker.value.
Add the early-return guard to handlePassive before any mapping or continuation.yield.
Add the same guard to handleActive before Enter/Escape handling.
Write CGEvent tests for marked/unmarked events.
Record in the PR description that the gesture state is usually idle at insertion time, so this is hardening rather than a currently reproducing bug.

tests.description: A key-down CGEvent with eventSourceUserData = marker is reported synthetic.
The same event with a different user-data value is not synthetic.
A plain CGEvent with no user data is not synthetic.

acceptance_criteria: Both callback paths check the marker before mapping/yielding/swallowing.
No change to non-synthetic Fn/right-Command/Enter/Escape behavior.
HotkeyEngine tests pass.

tasks.title: Prepare and safe insertion deadline at record start/submit
tasks.description: Call prepareForInsertion() immediately after reading the frontmost bundle id and before warm-up, raise the insert deadline from 3 s to an injectable 8 s default, and make the catch path write the transcript to the clipboard before claiming it is there. Extend TestKit recording doubles and assert the order.

files.what: Add insertionDeadline init parameter (default .seconds(8)); replace insertionMs; call await inserter.prepareForInsertion() after frontmostBundleID and before createSession/warm-up; in catch, try? await inserter.insert(text, strategy: .clipboardOnly) before the notice.
RecordingInserter: prepareCalls counter and ordered events ['frontmost','prepare','insert'].
FakeSpeechRecognizer: optional onWarmUp closure invoked at the start of warmUp(profile:).
Assert one prepare call, order prepare-before-warmUp-before-insert, and the deadline fallback writes clipboardOnly.

subtasks.description: Add insertionDeadline: Duration = .seconds(8) to SessionEngine.init and store it.
Replace withDeadline(.milliseconds(insertionMs)) with withDeadline(insertionDeadline).
Insert await inserter.prepareForInsertion() in start() after frontmostBundleID and before createSession/warm-up.
In the insertion catch, try? await inserter.insert(text, strategy: .clipboardOnly) before emitting the notice.
Add prepareCalls and ordered events (frontmost/prepare/insert) to RecordingInserter; add onWarmUp to FakeSpeechRecognizer.
Write a test with a shared log asserting frontmost -> prepare -> warmUp -> insert.
Write a test with insertionDeadline .milliseconds(10) and a slow .auto insert that records the .clipboardOnly fallback.

tests.description: start() calls prepareForInsertion() exactly once before warmUp.
stop() still calls insert(_:strategy:) after prepare.
A start failure after prepare does not insert.
A deadline hit triggers a .clipboardOnly fallback before the notice.

acceptance_criteria: prepareForInsertion() runs before warm-up and before createSession in start().
The insertion deadline defaults to 8 s and is injectable for tests.
The catch path attempts a clipboardOnly write before claiming the text is on the clipboard.
SessionEngine and TestKit tests pass.

tasks.title: ADR, permissions runbook, and full verification
tasks.description: Record the insertion-backend decisions in an ADR, update the permissions runbook with the stale-TCC diagnosis and reset command, update PLAN.md section 15 (500 ms, verification, AX fallback, secure-field policy), then run the full build/test/lint and the manual matrix.
building_blocks: ADR 0021: types, marker, target resolution, clipboard policy, secure field policy, secure input

files.what: Short ADR: why TextInsertionResult is local, why AXTextTarget is @MainActor, marker contract, prepared-PID TTL, target resolution, 500 ms restore, secure-field and secure-input policy.
Add a stale-TCC section: ad-hoc/unsigned rebuilds change identity; AXIsProcessTrusted false though toggle is ON; stable signing + tccutil reset Accessibility <bundle.id>.
Section 15: 250 ms -> 500 ms, character-count verification, AX fallback, synthetic marker, and secure-field policy matching the code (never insert; Island Copy button rather than auto-clipboard).

subtasks.description: Write docs/adr/0021-text-insertion-backend.md with the decisions and rejected alternatives.
Add the stale-Accessibility diagnosis and tccutil reset command to docs/runbooks/permissions.md.
Update PLAN.md section 15: delay, verification, AX fallback, marker, and secure-field policy.
Run the four package test/build commands and make lint; fix any warnings they surface.
Run make verify if time permits; otherwise record the exact commands and results.
Manual matrix: TextEdit, Notes, Slack, Chrome, VS Code, Terminal, password field, Finder desktop; check report.steps and confirm no transcript in logs.

PLAN.md and code agree on the 500 ms restore, verification, and secure-field policy.
